posts.title: Vanan Murugesan on what’s next for Sahan Journal, which covers immigrant communities in Minnesota
posts.description: On the latest “What Works” podcast, Ellen Clegg and I talk with Vanan Murugesan, executive director of Sahan Journal, a nonprofit newsroom in Minnesota covering, as they put it, “the people and communities reshaping” the North Star State.
